name: Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers
description: Ahsoka Tano owned a green-bladed lightsaber during the Clone Wars. Built under the tutelage of the ancient droid Professor Huyang when she was a very young Padawan, after returning from securing her Adegan crystal on Ilum, the lightsaber blade was a brilliant green. Tano used the lightsaber in many battles of the Clone Wars, such as Teth, Geonosis, Pantora, Lola Sayu, Felucia and Mon Calamari. She later wielded a lightsaber shoto alongside it.
